zh.title: 加拿大西捷航空客艙組員展開罷工 已致逾三百航班取消
zh.summary: 加拿大西捷航空約4,400名客艙組員因勞資談判破裂，於2026年8月2日正式發動罷工，導致超過300個航班取消。本次罷工主要影響波音737與787機隊營運，爭議焦點集中於起飛前與降落後地面勤務的薪資給付。由Dash 8 Q400營運的WestJet Encore及代碼共享航班則維持正常。
body: 加拿大西捷航空（WestJet）空服員於2026年8月2日正式展開罷工行動。在此之前，西捷航空與代表空服員的加拿大公共員工工會（CUPE）8125分會進行了長達將近11個月的團體協約談判，但最終未能達成新協議。罷工事件發生後，航空公司已在全航網範圍內取消超過300個航班，營運受到嚴重干擾。
本次罷工行動共涉及約4,400名客艙組員。為了降低營運混亂並避免乘客與飛機滯留外站，西捷航空在罷工正式開始前，已著手提前停飛部分波音737機隊。工會方面則表示，儘管談判代表持續努力至最後一刻，希望能達成一份合理反映客艙組員工作價值的協議，但資方提出的方案仍無法符合工會期待。
勞資雙方的爭議核心，在於客艙組員在航班起飛前與降落後所執行的各項地面勤務應如何給付報酬。工會主張這些重要職責在現行薪資體系下並未獲得合理給付；西捷航空則說明現有薪資模型已涵蓋相關工作，且公司在最新的團體協約方案中，已納入起飛前與降落後全額勤務給付，並承諾在合約第一年提供雙位數的薪資調幅。
在受影響的航班範疇方面，西捷航空確認由波音737與波音787機型執飛的航班受到罷工影響而取消。不過，由WestJet Encore營運、使用De Havilland Dash 8 Q400客機執航的區域航班，以及由合作夥伴航空公司營運的代碼共享航班，均維持按預定時程正常運作。

en.title: WestJet Cabin Crew Launch Strike Following Failed Talks, Over 300 Flights Canceled
en.summary: Approximately 4,400 WestJet flight attendants officially went on strike on August 2, 2026, after nearly 11 months of contract negotiations between the airline and CUPE Local 8125 failed to produce a collective agreement. The strike action has forced WestJet to cancel more than 300 flights across its network, impacting services operated by Boeing 737 and Boeing 787 aircraft. At the heart of the labor dispute is compensation for pre-flight and post-flight duties. Meanwhile, regional flights operated by WestJet Encore using De Havilland Dash 8 Q400 aircraft and partner codeshare services continue to run as scheduled.
body: WestJet flight attendants officially commenced strike action on August 2, 2026, after nearly 11 months of contract negotiations between the airline and the Canadian Union of Public Employees (CUPE) Local 8125 failed to yield a new collective agreement. The labor action has forced WestJet to cancel more than 300 flights across its operating network as negotiations broke down without a deal.

The strike involves approximately 4,400 cabin crew members across the airline. Ahead of the deadline, WestJet had already begun grounding portions of its Boeing 737 passenger fleet in a deliberate effort to mitigate operational disruption and avoid stranding aircraft and passengers across various airports. Union leadership noted that bargaining representatives worked until the final minutes to negotiate a fair deal that recognizes the value of cabin crew duties, but stated that WestJet's offer did not go far enough.

A primary point of contention between the two parties centers on how flight attendants are compensated for work performed before departure and after arrival. CUPE Local 8125 argues that these essential duties remain unpaid under the existing pay system. Conversely, WestJet stated that these responsibilities are already factored into its current compensation structure, adding that its latest offer included explicit pay for all pre-flight and post-flight responsibilities along with a double-digit wage increase in the contract's first year.

WestJet clarified that while flight operations using Boeing 737 and Boeing 787 aircraft are affected by the cabin crew strike, other segments of its network remain active. Regional flights under WestJet Encore operated with De Havilland Dash 8 Q400 aircraft, as well as partner codeshare services operated by allied airlines, continue to fly as scheduled without disruption.

zh.title: 聯合航空宣布於主要樞紐推出12條全新國內航線
zh.summary: 根據航空媒體報導，聯合航空宣布在其主要樞紐機場啟動大規模的航線擴展計劃，一舉推出12條全新的航線。這批全新航線全部都屬於國內航線，並未包含任何國際航點，該媒體亦提供了對應的航線地圖資訊。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 8 月 2 日的最新報導，聯合航空（United Airlines）宣布在其主要樞紐機場啟動了一項大規模的航線擴展計劃。在此次擴張中，該航空公司一舉推出了 12 條全新航線。
報導明確指出，這 12 條全新開闢的航線全部都屬於國內航線，並未涉及任何國際目的地。此外，該媒體也在報導中配合提供了相關的航線地圖資訊。該航線網絡擴展計劃的具體細節仍有待後續公布。

en.title: United Airlines Launches 12 New Domestic Routes From Major Hub
en.summary: According to an announcement reported by the aviation news outlet Simple Flying, United Airlines is initiating a massive network expansion by launching twelve new routes from one of its major hubs. The report highlights that all of these newly introduced routes are domestic services, meaning that no international destinations are part of this specific service expansion. Additionally, the coverage includes a route map detail to assist passengers in visualizing the upcoming flight network changes.
body: According to a report by aviation news outlet Simple Flying on August 2, 2026, United Airlines has announced a massive expansion of its route network from a major hub. Under this new expansion plan, the airline is launching a total of twelve new routes.

The report explicitly highlights that all of these twelve newly launched routes are domestic services, with no international destinations included in this specific expansion. Additionally, the media outlet has provided an accompanying route map alongside the route announcement details. Currently, further operational details regarding the schedules of these flights remain to be disclosed.
